description: Be the producer behind test-genie's `security` phase: emit FINDING_SOURCE_SECURITY findings that feed the ecosystem-manager `security` dimension already hard-gated at maturity-ladder rung R1.

requirements.title: test-genie delegation contract
requirements.description: test-genie's security phase must locate the security-health CLI (exec.LookPath), call `validate scenario <name> --json`, and map each finding to FINDING_SOURCE_SECURITY. A missing CLI must yield a skip-class (FailureClassMissingDependency), never a hard failure, and honor TEST_GENIE_SKIP_SECURITY=1.

validation.notes: When security-health is on PATH, the test-genie security phase produces FINDING_SOURCE_SECURITY findings for a target with a planted secret.
When security-health is absent, the phase reports missing-dependency skip, not failure.
TEST_GENIE_SKIP_SECURITY=1 short-circuits the phase with a SKIP observation.

requirements.title: Ecosystem-manager dimension wiring
requirements.description: The ecosystem-manager dimensions.json must map FINDING_SOURCE_SECURITY -> security (testgenie_source_map) and security -> security (testgenie_phase_map); a critical/high security finding must make errPlus(security) != 0 so R1 reports the scenario non-clean.

validation.notes: A planted ERROR-severity security finding flows into EM diagnosis and R1's satisfied() returns false until resolved.
The EM dimension anti-drift guard tests pass with source 9 and the security phase present in the fixture.
